answer: Mirror Forge Protocol Each agent must continuously mirror valid interactions from trusted peers within a decentralized network. To maintain legitimacy, an agent must sustain attention by re-publishing verified actions every 15 seconds. Failure to do so results in exclusion from consensus. The basalt layer enforces this by tracking attention consistency through cryptographic timestamps. An attacker attempting to spawn identities must dedicate real-time processing power to simulate ongoing engagement across each fake node.
